post.description: Registers a new user and sends an email verification link.

full_name.description: Alphanumeric username (no spaces or special chars)

notes.example: This is an optional note about the user

address.description: User address, supports letters, numbers, commas, and dots

phone_number.description: Valid phone number (8–15 digits, may start with +)

role_id.description: Existing role ID (foreign key to roles table)

password.description: Min 12 chars, must include uppercase, lowercase, number, and special character

message.example: User registered successfully. Check email for verification code

items.example: The email has already been taken.

post.summary: Authenticate user and send 2FA code via email
post.description: Validates user credentials. If valid, sends a 6-digit verification code to the user's email for 2FA.

200.description: Login successful, verification code sent to email

post.description: Verifies a 6-digit login code sent via email. If valid, returns an access token and refresh token.

post.summary: Refresh access token using refresh token

put.description: Updates the authenticated user's profile information. Requires Bearer token authentication.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the user to update (should match the authenticated user ID)

items.example: The email has already been taken.

delete.description: Deletes the authenticated user's account and all associated tokens. Requires Bearer token authentication.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the user to delete (should match the authenticated user ID)

get.summary: Get all users with specific roles
get.description: Returns a list of all users who have role_id 1, 2, 3, 4, or 5. Only accessible by admin users (role_id = 1).

message.example: Verification Code sent to your email

post.summary: Verify Verification Code for password reset

401.description: Invalid Verification Code or email not found

400.description: New password cannot be the same as current password

error.example: New password cannot be the same as current password

get.description: Handles email verification requests. If the email is already verified, it returns a relevant message or redirects to the frontend. If not verified, it fulfills verification and redirects or responds with JSON.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the user whose email is being verified

200.description: Email verified or already verified (JSON response)

302.description: Redirects to frontend confirmation page with status parameter

get.summary: Generate a temporary email verification link for the authenticated user
